query:
SELECT person_id AS "person_id!: Uuid", role AS "role!: Role"
               FROM public.memberships
               WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND person_id = $2 AND status = 'active'
               ORDER BY CASE role
                 WHEN 'owner' THEN 0
                 WHEN 'admin' THEN 1
                 WHEN 'instructor' THEN 2
                 WHEN 'guardian' THEN 3
                 WHEN 'student' THEN 4
               END
